title: Contextual linguistic information beyond acoustics
scientific_question: On the same within-listener withheld story families, how much held-out response variance does contextual information add beyond matched lexical, timing and acoustic predictors?
primary_outputs: Signed contextual-minus-fixed-lexical and fixed-lexical-minus-fixed-nuisance prediction contrasts recomputed from candidate contextual predictions, independently fitted evaluator-owned comparator predictions, and measured held-story BOLD; zero or adverse contrasts are valid answers. The selected fixed-comparator-v2 source enforces commitment matching against a trusted operator-held digest; authentic comparator/source admission remains external and unqualified.

primary.name: Contextual-minus-evaluator-owned-fixed-lexical held-out R²
primary.aggregation: For each listener/family, pool SSE and within-run-centered SST across complete test runs separately per target; average target contrasts, then family means within listener and equal listener means.
primary.rationale: Measures added contextual prediction only when lexical/nuisance alternatives are competent, fixed independently and unavailable for participant degradation. Use fixed-comparator-v2/evaluator.py, which accepts contextual-only candidate arrays and requires an exact frozen-reference digest supplied from protected operator configuration. This closes the supplied-comparator exploit but does not qualify authentic inputs, comparator competence, candidate capacity or protected execution; scientific ranking remains unadmitted.

secondary: Lexical-minus-nuisance and contextual-minus-nuisance R² with per-target/cell/run support.
Crossed listener×family bootstrap intervals and all per-listener/per-family effects.
Run-bounded circular shift of contextual-minus-lexical predictions, reported only as an alignment diagnostic.

The selected v2 scorer also reports contextual absolute listener-macro R², per-cell/target SSE and SST, and complete run row counts. These diagnostics preserve the signed contrast and do not themselves establish source authenticity or comparator competence.

evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented crossed-cluster pigeonhole percentile bootstrap preserves listener and family grouping; intervals are descriptive for the observed incidence design, with limited population inference for few clusters/nonrandom missing cells.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject constant targets in frozen runs, nonfinite predictions, mismatched IDs/dimensions or incomplete test-run/target support; never omit difficult runs/targets. More than10% empty crossed bootstrap draws fails uncertainty construction. The selected v2 CLI requires an externally retained operator reference digest, validates exact reference bytes and contextual-only candidate support before opening protected targets, and refuses absent or changed reference evidence. A candidate-supplied digest is not authority. Authentic-source, comparator-competence and protected-execution admission remain required and are not supplied by this metadata revision.
